title: History, Power and Justice
description: Examines the historical forces, processes and events that have shaped diverse human societies around the world since 1400. Topics include: the rise and fall of empires; the impact of colonialism on Indigenous cultures; slavery and other forms of coercive labour; social and economic transformations brought by globalization; and varied human struggles for freedom and equality.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 100, HSTR 101A (if taken in 202109).
Required for History Majors and Honours students
